class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = "customers"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    email = Column(String, unique=True)


class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orders"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("customers.id"))
    status = Column(String)
    total_cents = Column(Integer)


class OrderItem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "order_items"
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("orders.id"))
    sku = Column(String)
    quantity = Column(Integer)

class Settings(BaseSettings):
    database_url: str
    redis_url: str = "redis://localhost:6379/0"
    stripe_api_key: str
    stripe_webhook_secret: str
    smtp_host: str = "localhost"
    rate_limit_per_minute: int = 60

# Orders service

Architecture: a FastAPI API receives orders, reserves stock in Redis, stores orders in Postgres and hands email notifications to a Celery worker. Payments go through Stripe. The process flow is: create order, reserve stock, charge payment, send confirmation.

# Deployment

Merges to main build a Docker image in CI, push it to ECR and roll out the ECS service orders-api. Database migrations run with Alembic before the rollout.

@router.post("/webhooks/stripe")
async def stripe_webhook(request: Request):
    payload = await request.body()
    signature = request.headers.get("Stripe-Signature")
    event = stripe.Webhook.construct_event(payload, signature, settings.stripe_webhook_secret)
    handle_event(event)
    return {"received": True}
